messages:
alex (oncall): getting paged — customers reporting 5xxs on /v2/prompt-route. alerts spiking in us-west-2 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Paging oncall (alex) — severity: S2 — 5xx spike on prompt-routing-new-endpoint. See /incidents/1789998000
alex (oncall): reading logs now, looks like new experimental route rollout (flag: prompt_route_v2) just hit ~20% canary 2m ago
maya (sre): confirmed errors in nginx upstream healthchecks to runtime pool: 502s and streaming aborts. CPU on a few pods at 95%
trent (runtime): i'm pulling the router logs. initial hypothesis: kernel/quantized runner dropping connections under long-polling streams for hallucination-guard path
sara (product): is customer impact large? any major accounts affected?
alex (oncall): metric shows error budget burn for PLG tier, a handful of enterprise accounts see degraded latency and some 5xx responses. tagging customer-team for heads up
customer-team: we're seeing user sessions fail to complete LLM responses, affecting autocomplete on two customers. will open support tickets if this persists
trent (runtime): stack trace snippet:
```
2026-02-12T14:23:55Z router[pid=82] ERROR connection lost to worker-quant-05: write: broken pipe
... kv-cache flush triggered during attach_stream() 
```
trent (runtime): i can repro locally with long streaming prompt when runtime uses quantized kernels + prefilling. suspect a regression from last night deploy that updated kernel selection logic
maya (sre): we should stop traffic to prompt_route_v2 immediately. recommend emergency flag kill-switch then validate fallback to stable route
alex (oncall): agreed — i'm going to flip the kill. calling the kill now. anyone object?
sara (product): do it. prioritize stability, we'll annotate release notes
alex (oncall): executing: `curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood/api/toggle" -d '{"flag":"prompt_route_v2","state":"off","reason":"emergency 5xx spike"}'`
deploy-bot: Feature flag prompt_route_v2 set to OFF by alex (oncall) — rollout: immediate — change_id: ff-20260212-179
trent (runtime): seeing immediate drop in error rate on router metrics, 5xxs decrease within 20s. nice work
maya (sre): checking downstream: traffic has fallen to stable route, latency returning to baseline, tracing shows requests hitting prompt_route_v1 as expected
alex (oncall): customer-team can you confirm reduced impact on the customers?
customer-team: confirmed — both customers report responses are flowing again. will follow up with support case notes. :thumbsup:
trent (runtime): need a followup to root cause. will roll a debug build to a staging canary and reproduce quantized attach_stream behavior. suspect a guard in kernel selector that doesn't set keepalive on certain paths
maya (sre): logging postmortem placeholder created: /incidents/postmortems/1789998000-kill-switch-on-prompt-route.md. filling timeline and impact now
sara (product): can we draft an external status blurb? i can push to status page once we have sanitized details
alex (oncall): status blurb draft: "We detected increased errors for the new prompt routing endpoint (prompt_route_v2) during a canary rollout. We disabled the experimental flag to restore service while engineering investigates. No customer data was exposed. We'll provide updates after RCA."
trent (runtime): for oncall handoff: i'll take lead on RCA, need 2-3 hours to reproduce and instrument. if anything else bubbles, page me or escalate to infra lead
alex (oncall): handing off after cleanup — ping me on thread if you need anything during the RCA. i'm marking incident as mitigated in the incident tracker and closing the active page
incident-bot: Incident 1789998000 — mitigated — status: degraded->operational — oncall: alex -> handoff -> trent — duration: 6m5s
maya (sre): i've scheduled a canary freeze for the remainder of the day and updated the deploy runbook to require extra perf smoke for quantized kernels
trent (runtime): to keep track: planned next steps:
- reproduce with quantized runner + streaming test corpus
- add fail-safe keepalive in kernel selection path
- re-run canary at 1% with aggressive tracing
- prepare rollback plan if we see error burst
(sara product): will coordinate customer comms and notify customers in the support tickets once RCA draft is ready
alex (oncall): thanks all. closing thread for live mitigation; please append RCA notes and timeline to the postmortem doc.
trent (runtime): adding initial reproducer command here for the RCA:
```bash
pytest tests/e2e/test_streaming.py::test_long_prompt_quant --reuse-kv --runner=quantized --workers=3
```
maya (sre): tagging this for followup during the weekly reliability sync. also recommending an automated run of the streaming smoke tests before any kernel selector changes land
customer-team: closing our ticket entries as resolved for now; we'll reopen if anything recurs
alex (oncall): last check: monitoring shows stable metrics, no further 5xx spikes in last 5 minutes. everyone stay on standby for the RCA notes. :white_check_mark:
